steps: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Lean forward a little, then stand up tall. Use your hands on your knees if you need to.
Sit back down slowly and with control.
sit_to_stand.tip: Put the chair against a wall so it can't slide.
sit_to_stand.camera: Phone 2–3 metres away, so your hips and knees are in the picture.

steps: Sit in the middle of the chair with your arms crossed over your chest.
When the timer starts, stand up fully, then sit back down.
Repeat as many times as you safely can in 30 seconds.
chair_stand_test.tip: Stop if you feel dizzy or unsteady. Have someone nearby.
chair_stand_test.camera: Phone 2–3 metres away, side-on or facing you, hips and knees in view.

steps: Stand tall with your arms by your sides.
Slowly raise both arms in front of you and up over your head.
Lower them slowly. Breathe out as you lower.
arm_raise.tip: Only lift as high as feels comfortable.
arm_raise.camera: Your shoulders and both hands in the picture.

steps: Sit tall near the front of your chair, feet flat on the floor.
Slowly raise both arms in front of you and up over your head.
Lower them slowly. Breathe out as you lower.
seated_arm_raise.tip: Keep your back supported if you need to.
seated_arm_raise.camera: Your head, shoulders and both hands in the picture. Your legs don't need to show.

steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting into a chair.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
squats.tip: Keep your knees in line with your toes.
squats.camera: Your whole body in the picture.

steps: Stand tall next to a chair or wall for support.
Lift one knee towards hip height, then lower it.
Swap legs and keep a steady rhythm.
standing_march.tip: Hold on to the chair if you feel wobbly.
standing_march.camera: Your whole body in the picture.

steps: Stand next to a chair and hold it lightly.
Lift one foot just off the floor.
Hold still and breathe. Swap feet when the time is up.
balance_hold.tip: Grip the chair again whenever you need to.
balance_hold.camera: Your whole body in the picture.

steps: Stand with soft knees and your fists by your chin.
Punch one arm forward, then pull it back.
Swap arms. Keep your core tight.
punches.tip: Don't lock your elbows at full stretch.
punches.camera: Your shoulders and both hands in the picture.

steps: Stand with feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart as your arms go up overhead.
Jump back to the start. Step instead of jumping for a gentler version.
jumping_jacks.tip: Land softly on the balls of your feet.
jumping_jacks.camera: Your whole body in the picture.

steps: Sit near the front of your chair, feet flat.
Lift your chest, relax your shoulders and look ahead.
Stay tall and still, breathing slowly.
seated_tall_hold.tip: Lean back to rest whenever you need to.
seated_tall_hold.camera: Your head and shoulders in the picture.

steps: Crouch down low like a frog, hands near the floor.
Spring up with a small hop.
Land softly on bent knees, then crouch again.
frog_jump.tip: Small, soft hops. No big jumps.
frog_jump.camera: Your whole body in the picture.

steps: Stand tall like a flamingo.
Lift one foot and tuck it next to your other knee.
Stay still and count. Swap legs if you wobble.
flamingo_balance.tip: Arms out wide like wings help you balance.
flamingo_balance.camera: Your whole body in the picture.

steps: Stand tall with your paws (hands) up.
Lift one knee high and stomp it down.
Now the other knee. Big bear stomps!
bear_steps.tip: Stomp gently: bears are strong, not loud.
bear_steps.camera: Your hips and knees in the picture.

steps: Bend your knees a little and hold your claws (hands) up.
Take a big step to the side.
Bring your feet together, then step again.
crab_walk.tip: Make sure there is space around you.
crab_walk.camera: Your whole body in the picture, with room to move sideways.

steps: Sit or stand comfortably and relax your shoulders.
Breathe in slowly as your arms float up.
Breathe out slowly as your arms float down.
breathing.tip: Go at your own pace. There is no wrong way.
breathing.camera: Your shoulders and both hands in the picture.
